name: PathUSD
oneLiner: pathUSD is Tempo's quote stablecoin; mint via USDC deposit and redeem through Bridge into a reserve of cash, short Treasuries, repo, and MMF exposure.
collateral: Bridge-managed reserve assets for Tempo pathUSD, including cash, short-dated Treasuries, overnight Treasury repo, and money-market-fund exposure
pegMechanism: Tempo users mint pathUSD by depositing USDC.e through Bridge-supported exchange flows and redeem pathUSD back into USDC through Bridge rails

applicabilityBasis.summary: pathUSD functions as Tempo routing and quote-token infrastructure; its payment-stablecoin treatment remains less clear than consumer-facing Bridge issued stablecoins.

genius.notes: Tempo describes pathUSD as optional routing infrastructure rather than a general consumer-facing stablecoin; no token-specific public GENIUS approval was located.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
Bridge issuance documentation and legal terms
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for pathUSD.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

notices.title: Tempo-native issuer rail
notices.message: pathUSD is tracked as a Tempo quote token. Pharos models its Bridge redemption route, but there is no independent live reserve adapter for the Bridge reserve portfolio yet.

mintAuthority.summary: pathUSD is Tempo's TIP-20 quote stablecoin issued via Bridge (a FinCEN-registered MSB); the administrative authority over the precompile token can mint and burn supply arbitrarily, and mint/redeem runs through Bridge against its reserve portfolio.

controls.label: pathUSD TIP-20 token administrator (Tempo/Bridge)
controls.evidence: pathUSD is a TIP-20 precompile token whose administrative authority can mint or burn arbitrarily; Tempo/Bridge controls supply creation, and primary mint/redeem flows through Bridge MSB rails against custodied reserves.

review.evidence: Tempo docs describe pathUSD as a TIP-20 precompile stablecoin where the administrative authority can mint/burn arbitrarily; Bridge (FinCEN MSB) operates issuance and redemption against a cash/Treasury/repo/MMF reserve, with no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain TIP-20 administrator address/role for pathUSD before raising confidence.
